function: Predicts next-step downlink CSI from past uplink CSI sequences (channel prediction) with a modality-aligned pre-trained LLM, TDD and FDD; p. 3.
system: MISO-OFDM, BS dual-polarized 4x4 UPA, single-antenna users, 2.4 GHz uplink carrier (FDD downlink on adjacent band), 8.64 MHz bandwidth; no RIS; p. 8.
method: GPT-2 (first 6 layers) fine-tuned with LoRA, cross-modal attention alignment and semantic prompts; lightweight student via attention-relation distillation; supervised NMSE plus alignment loss; p. 5-8.
data_channel: QuaDRiGa time-varying 3GPP UMa channels, users 10-100 km/h; 9000 train, 1000 validation, 1000 test samples; zero-shot UMi and highway tests; p. 8, 10-11.
test_conditions: Trained on UMa; tested on UMa, zero-shot on UMi (TDD, FDD) and highway FDD (50-120 km/h); also 10% training data, noisy historical CSI; p. 8-11.
baselines: Non-learned: no-prediction (outdated CSI) curve. Learned: CNN, RNN, GRU, LSTM, Transformer, and LLM4CP [35]; ablations without LLM, cross-modal attention, prompt; p. 8, 11.
metrics: NMSE versus user speed, SNR of historical CSI, few-shot and zero-shot; average NMSE (Table I); parameters and inference time (Table II); p. 8-12.
complexity: Table II: CSI-ALM 11.8 M trainable, 93.8 M total parameters, 198.2 ms inference; CSI-ALM-Light 0.349 M, 2.41 ms; baselines listed; p. 12.
openness: none; no code or data link in the paper.
q1_support: p. 8: "QuaDRiGa [38] to generate a time-varying CSI dataset that complies with the 3GPP standard"; same page: "We consider the 3GPP Urban Macro (UMa) channel model".
q2_support: p. 10: "training them in the Uma scenario and directly applying them to the Umi scenario"; Fig. 15 (p. 11) adds a zero-shot highway FDD test.
q3_support: p. 8: "we employ CNN [21], RNN [22], GRU [24], LSTM [23], Transformer [25], and the existing LLM-based LLM4CP [35] as baseline methods"; non-learned "No-Prediction" curve in Fig. 7 (p. 8); all compared on NMSE.
q4_support: p. 13: "We also compare the parameter counts and inference times of different models"; Table II (p. 12) lists CSI-ALM 11.8M trainable, 93.8M total parameters and 198.2ms inference.
q5_support: p. 8: "QuaDRiGa [38] to generate a time-varying CSI dataset"; not met: the dataset is generated by the authors and the paper gives no link to code or data.
notes: Area 2: next-step downlink CSI prediction from uplink history. The No-Prediction baseline (outdated CSI) is only named in figure legends (Fig. 7, p. 8) and described by one sentence on p. 8, so the reviewer should confirm it. The training scenario of the highway test (Fig. 15) is not stated; the UMa-to-UMi test (p. 10) is explicit. Few-shot with 10% of the data (p. 9) is not counted for q2.
